journey.name: LC-05 A cold start returns to the four seed rows
journey.description:
Not a defect - a deviation, recorded as D-2 in REQUIREMENTS.md section 4 and argued in WALKTHROUGH.md section 4. The store is a MutableList inside FakeTaskApi, rebuilt from SEED_TASKS in its init block, so killing the process discards everything the user did and the app comes back to exactly four rows.
This journey exists to make the boundary explicit rather than surprising, and because it is also the suite's reset protocol: every other journey depends on this being true.
It also pins the documented cut that the list's search and sort are not restored across process death (WALKTHROUGH.md section 6), which is the one place a passing journey records an intentional absence.
Preconditions: adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Add task"
Type "Written on water" into the "Title" field
Verify that "Written on water" is on screen
Tap the element with the content description "Sort tasks"
Using adb, force-stop the app and launch it again with --es qa_failure_rate 0.0
Verify that "Written on water" is not on screen
Verify that "Renew domain registration" is the first row
Verify that exactly four elements with the content description "Delete task" are on screen
Verify that the "Search by title" field is empty
